varqec_cao.t: Quantum variational learning for quantum error-correcting codes
varqec_cao.note: the paper that introduces the name VarQEC; learns the ENCODING (code discovery) from Knill-Laflamme-inspired cost functions, not the recovery

varqec_meyer.t: Learning encodings by maximizing state distinguishability: Variational quantum error correction
varqec_meyer.note: second paper using the VarQEC name; distinguishability loss for encoding circuits, IBM and IQM proof-of-concept runs

berthusen_ase.note: measures only the stabilizer generators likely to carry syndrome information; [[4,2,2]] concatenated with a hypergraph product code; >order of magnitude lower logical error with fewer gates and qubits

xin_lru.t: Improved Error Correction with Leakage Reduction Units Built into Qubit Measurement in a Superconducting Quantum Processor
authors: Sean L. M. van der Meer
xin_lru.note: DDROP-derived LRU concurrent with 2-level readout: 98.4% leakage removal at 99.2% assignment fidelity; LRU-enhanced measurement + leakage-informed NN decoding suppress logical error in memory and stability experiments with NO post-selection

biswas_syndrome_petz.t: Universal syndrome-based recovery for noise-adapted quantum error correction
biswas_syndrome_petz.j: arXiv preprint (no CrossRef journal record as of 2026-09-22)
biswas_syndrome_petz.source: arXiv API (v1 2025-10-09, v2 2026-09-09); crossref search returns no journal version
biswas_syndrome_petz.note: algorithmic construction of syndromes for arbitrary codes and noise, then a syndrome-based variant of the Petz map implementable by syndrome measurement; amplitude damping on the 4-qubit code, IBM hardware break-even with up to 3x T1 improvement
